key_terms.حَمٓ: Disjointed letters Ha and Mim, appearing at the start of Surah Ash-Shura and others.

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Quranic opening letters Ha Mim?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the disjointed letters 'Ha' and 'Mim' are often interpreted as abbreviations for divine attributes or names, such as 'Ana Allah A'lam' (I am Allah, the All-Knowing), emphasizing the Quran's divine origin. These letters serve as a rhetorical challenge to the skeptics of Mecca, highlighting the inimitability (I'jaz) of the Quranic text and inviting reflection on its profound guidance.
